criteria.text: An unpowered or occluded camera provides no coverage
Hidebehind never advances through a watched, connected corridor (full overlapping coverage: no intrusion, no advance onto a watched stretch)
With full powered coverage you can sleep the night through: no intrusion, no wake-up (no forced sleeplessness loop)
Removing a node opens a gap it uses; the perimeter alarm warns before any intrusion, and restoring coverage stops it (recoverable)
When the power fails the cameras give no coverage; the alarm still warns before the intrusion
Dogman cannot learn an unobserved route; changing routine has a measurable effect
4/5 testers can identify a coverage failure and its remedy
